{{Quote|A depiction of the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer in their battle for Sith supremacy circa 3400 BBY. Both died, overcome by the vapors from the Pits of Paxxis.|Annotation by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Deluxe" />}}
[[File:DreamerMonsterSlayer-BookOfSith.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer duel at the Pits of Paxxis.]]
